## The mode
test_only_input: the product is correct at the tip; the defect is a missing assertion in three test files. The new cells must go
RED when the product regresses, and the diff touches only the three test files.

## What is wrong
KS-1783 (Linear, read): three L6 cells titled "simulated true with a real hash" take the hash from the `chainReply` helper default
(`txHash: REAL_TX`) and assert nothing about it. The presenter marks a reply simulated from a placeholder-shaped hash alone
(`FABRICATED_TXHASH_RE`, `routes/verification.ts:52`; `const simulated = Boolean(b.simulated) || (tx !== undefined && FABRICATED_TXHASH_RE.test(tx));` at :60),
so a cell meant to prove that the reply's `simulated` is CARRIED must send a hash the regex does not match, and must say so in an
assertion. `REAL_TX_SHAPE` is already in the v2 file (:49, used at :159/:173 by the two N3 cells only) and in neither verify file.
Existing cells (read at the tip): v2 :117, verify-route :107, verify-file :102, each `chainReply({ simulated: true })`.

## The exact change
Add ONE new cell per file, inserted directly after the existing "simulated true with a real hash" cell (golden.diff is the whole
change; copy it verbatim, hunks are git-form with correct counts). Edit points, at the tip:
1. `ks1634-a-simulated-anchor-verified-by-hash-verify-route.test.ts`: insert after :113 (current :113 is `  });`, :114 is blank,
   :115 is `  it('RED KS-1628 L6 verify: the shape anchoring really sends (simulated true, txHash null) is not on-chain', async () => {`).
   New cell: `KS-1783 L6 verify: a simulated reply with its own real-shaped hash is not on-chain`.
2. `ks1634-a-simulated-anchor-verified-by-hash.test.ts`: insert after :108 (current :108 is `  });`, :110 is
   `  it('RED KS-1628 L6 verify-file: the shape anchoring really sends (simulated true, txHash null) is not on-chain', async () => {`).
   New cell: `KS-1783 L6 verify-file: a simulated reply with its own real-shaped hash is not on-chain`.
3. `ks1634-v2-chain-only-match-carries-simulated.test.ts`: insert after :126 (current :126 is `  });`, :128 is
   `  it('CONTROL KS-1634 v2: a real confirmed anchor stays on-chain', async () => {`). Uses the file's existing top-level
   `REAL_TX_SHAPE` (:49). New cell: `KS-1783 L6 v2: a simulated reply with its own real-shaped hash reads NOT on-chain`.

Each new cell sends `chainReply({ simulated: true, txHash: '5'.repeat(64) })` (its OWN hash, not the helper default), asserts
`reply.txHash` matches the real-tx shape (the two verify files declare `const REAL_TX_SHAPE = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;` inside the cell,
so no new top-level declaration), then the same four (v2: seven) assertions the neighbouring cell makes.

Must NOT change: no existing line is edited or removed (pure insertion); `REAL_TX`, `chainReply`, `callSite`/`callV2`, every
existing cell and the jest.mock block stay as they are; no product file is touched.

## The test
The cells are in golden.diff. Run: `npx jest <the three files>` in `Blockchain/Dev/services/originate` (jest + ts-jest, config
`jest.config.js`, `testMatch **/__tests__/**/*.test.ts`).

## Plant
The regression the cells pin: a call site stops copying the reply's `simulated` into the blob it hands to `presentBlockchainHonestly`
(the original KS-1628/KS-1634 L6 defect). With a REAL-shaped hash the regex cannot rescue it, so the reply is presented as on-chain.

to: `              simulated: undefined,`

## UNMEASURED
- Whether the plant is the only regression these cells catch: they do NOT catch a placeholder-shaped `chainReply` default (that is
  a test-side input in the same files; a plant may not name a declared test file). What they add is that the real-hash premise is now
  asserted in the cell instead of inherited, and the cells survive a changed default.
- Whether lines 724 and 1267 each map to exactly one of the verify / verify-file cells (both are mutated together, so the plant does
  not tell which); the plan's A5 only needs each named cell to fail by assertion.
- That jest in the round harness resolves `@secuura/shared` for these files (the cells mock it; ts-jest type-checks).

## Scope
Test-only, three files, one cell each. Narrowing: closes the KS-1783 premise "hash not asserted real" for the three cells; it does
not change the helper defaults or add a placeholder-default case. No open PR touches any of the three files nor verification.ts /
verificationV2.ts (all 38 open PRs, 430 file entries, read via REST with pagination at draft time; planted control found).
